title: Faster pipe-chart PDF and photo loading
description:
PipeShare now loads job media for the open pipe run with one deep folder list (instead of many sequential folder fetches), then shows View PDF / View Photos as soon as files are known. Photo gallery thumbs use batch Wasabi presigns, and PDF/photo URLs are prefetched into a cache so opening them feels near-instant after the first resolve.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing pipe inspections on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Deep-list the pipe project once, then refresh media buttons immediately.
Skip redundant folder hydrates when files are already in the tree.
Batch-presign gallery photo URLs instead of one request per photo.
Prefetch PDF and photo preview URLs in the background after assets resolve.
Show a loading shell for PDF/photo while the first fetch finishes.
